title: Generation and assessment of high-quality mouse oocytes and embryos following nicotinamide mononucleotide administration
protocol: Pre-warm M2 medium to 37°C before use.
Prepare 1 mg/mL hyaluronidase with M2 medium and warm it up to 37°C for use.
Sacrifice mice by cervical dislocation after 12–14 hours of hCG injection.
Cut the oviduct between ovary and uterus out of mice and place it into M2 medium in a dish on the heating stage.
Release ovulated oocytes in M2 medium by tearing a hole in the ampulla of the oviduct with fine-tipped forceps.
Remove cumulus cells surrounding oocytes by brief incubation in 1 mg/mL hyaluronidase.
Wash oocytes in fresh M2 medium on the heating stage.
Fix 20–30 oocytes in 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA)/PBS (pH 7.4) at 20°C–25°C for 30 minutes.
Permeabilize oocytes in IF permeabilization medium at 20°C–25°C for 20 minutes.
Block oocytes in IF blocking buffer at 20°C–25°C for 1 hour.
Incubate oocytes with primary antibodies in the blocking buffer at 4°C for 12–16 hours.
Wash oocytes in IF washing buffer, and then incubate them with corresponding secondary antibodies at 20°C–25°C for 1 hour.
Counterstain oocytes with Hoechst 33342 (10 μg/mL) at 20°C–25°C for 10 minutes.
Mount 10 oocytes in 2 μL of antifade mountant on the microscope slides.
Seal the slide by coverslip with lanolin.
Incubate oocytes in M16 medium containing 500 nM cell permeant MitoTracker Red CMXRos for 30 min at 37°C with 5% CO2 for active mitochondrion staining.
Incubate oocytes in M16 medium containing 2 μM MitoProbe JC-1 for 30 min at 37°C with 5% CO2 for mitochondrial membrane potential assessment.
Incubate oocytes in M16 medium containing 10 μM dichlorofluorescein diacetate (DCFHDA) for 30 min at 37°C with 5% CO2 for DCFH staining.
Incubate oocytes in M16 medium containing 10% Annexin-V-FITC for 30 min at 37°C with 5% CO2 for Annexin-V staining.
Wash oocytes three times in 0.1% BSA/PBS.
Acquire images under the laser scanning confocal microscope immediately after mounting or store the slide at -20°C.
Apply Image J to define a region of interest (ROI) in the images, and determine the average fluorescence intensity per unit area within the ROI.
Compare the final average intensities between aged and NMN-supplemented groups.
Warm acidic Tyrode's solution and M2 medium to 37°C.
Transfer oocytes into 50 μL Tyrode's solution for 30 seconds to remove the zona pellucida (ZP).
Wash the oocytes by transferring them into warmed M2 medium immediately after ZP removal.
Recover oocytes in M2 medium for 10 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Transfer oocytes with as little M2 medium as possible into one drop of fixative on the microscope slide.
Observe oocyte dissolution under the microscope and leave the slide to air dry at 20°C–25°C for 30 minutes.
After air drying, stain the chromosomes with propidium iodide for 10 minutes.
Acquire images under the laser scanning confocal microscope.
Equilibrate HTF in the incubator for 12–16 hours before use.
Slice the cauda epididymides from 3-month-old male mice with fine-tipped forceps in HTF medium.
Incubate sperm in HTF medium at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 1 hour to capacitate.
Calculate sperm concentration using a computer-assisted sperm analysis system.
Add 4 × 10^5/mL capacitated sperm to 100 μL HTF containing 20–30 ovulated oocytes and 5 two-cell embryos at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 30 minutes of binding.
Wash sperm binding to the ovulated oocytes with a wide-bore pipette to remove all but 2–6 sperm on the two-cell embryos.
Equilibrate HTF in the incubator for 12–16 hours before use.
Equilibrate KSOM in the incubator for 12–16 hours before use.
Release sperm by slicing the cauda epididymides from 3-month-old male mice with fine-tipped forceps in HTF medium.
Incubate released sperm at 37°C for 1 hour to capacitate them in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 4 × 10^5/mL capacitated sperm to 100 μL HTF containing 20–30 ovulated oocytes at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 5 hours of incubation.
Observe the activity of sperm before addition to the oocytes.
Transfer fertilized oocytes to a 96-well culture plate containing 100 μL KSOM medium covered with mineral oil at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere for in vitro embryo culture for 4 days to blastocysts.
Do not frequently take embryos out of the incubator to observe development.
Incubate 4 × 10^5/mL capacitated sperm with ovulated oocytes in 100 μL HTF at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 hours.
